title: Storage capability intent
description: Diamond Standard (founder 2026-09-01): 'I need a place to store 5GB of image data' is the agent's absolute limit. Which cloud answers is the founder's DNA (ESTATE_STORAGE_PROVIDER in clusters/*/estate-config.yaml); bin/intent-compile writes the provider resource. There is no field for a provider, a bucket URL or a region on purpose.

access.description: private unless the founder's merge says otherwise; secure by default (LAW 21)
